chapter.heading: Psalm 29
Ascribe to the LORD Glory
A Psalm of David.
chapter.v: ascribe to the Lord glory and strength .
worship the Lord inthe splendor of holiness .
the voice of the Lord is full of majesty .
the Lord breaksthe cedars of Lebanon .
The voice of the Lord flashes forth flames of fire .
the Lord shakes the wilderness ofKadesh .
and in his temple all cry , “ Glory ! ”
the Lord sits enthronedas king forever .
May the Lord bless his people withpeace !
